title: Preserve brokerage column headings and printed totals
summary: The optional financial table reader preserves separate printed columns and recovers source-backed totals while flagging uncertain transaction rows.
bodyMarkdown:
## What changed

The optional financial table reader can separate a proven empty terminal column, keep printed divider lines out of amounts, and recover an adjacent gain or loss summary from the original PDF.

## Why it matters

A table can contain correct amounts but still have invalid transaction rows. Such rows now keep the result marked for review. Printed negative signs and source-page references are preserved.

## Where to find it

Use Extract Tables in the PDF toolbox when the optional financial table reader is enabled. General rollout remains under qualification; these changes do not approve tax facts.
